translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesu Wane Kop Okanŋem Ŋei Natne Edo Ŋonbi Menageake
Ŋene mali malipze togole pamaike, ŋedo ŋei zonomene midaine set pelek gemami, eŋe qesiŋ one, umatene teweke kau bisi ebukene. Ŋene ŋenzaneka simileze misuk desikene.
Ea wane turuŋine yemo ŋene bonep bonep kimakopze eŋane dereret ge more, gegeene menageakane, so mitiwo togoleu, mali malipene suayakane mapik onikene.

Kristo eŋe eninaneka simileine mi detke. Eŋinaneka desiakane turuŋine yemo Anutu wane papiao don mane iwa yale ramaike, ea wane kop okange, “Anutu, ŋetko liko liko okangangoi, ŋeiwa yewa eŋane ŋetko liko liko, eaŋo naŋane kutŋo wamaike.”

Don kine kine korop Anutu wane papia mo qewarekoi, eŋe ea qekoi yemo ŋene miti wane kine kito ŋedangi detlukkenane. Paki eaŋo ma togoleŋone more, ma ewek ŋongi, kine kine biŋek qe ŋebonge, ea wane dereret gekenane, qekoi.
So Anutu eŋe ma togole ma togole, so ma ewek ma ewek welaine, oŋo maine qesiŋŋungi, ŋine Yesu Kristo wane rokopko, wet dereret weku motpi paki gekei,
paki ŋine korop maine aŋa weku qeturageu paki, Anutu so Waomze Yesu Kristo wane Magaine bakomine kitokei.
Kristoŋo Yuda Ŋei So Qelaŋ Ŋei Weneŋ Qesiŋonge
Ea wane ŋine wetŋineŋo mali malip okan nagu gekei, Kristo eŋe yaleka Anutu wane qeli ewe zonom qelaŋan wakoniakane ŋine ŋibuke.

Na ŋidanmaile, yemo onoka wane Kristoŋo Yuda ŋei eŋane qelit ŋei okangi, eaŋo kine qeki wakonmaike, yemo Anutu eŋe qom pese welaine, paki, eŋe Anutuŋo aso ŋabo biŋek don edange, ea ma togoleki, wele wakoniakane, yale okange.
So eŋe yaleka qelaŋ ŋei mapikongi, Anutu qom borikinane bakomine kitokei wane, yale okange. Ea wane Anutu wane papiao don qekoi, eaŋo iwa yale ramaike,

content.text: “Eso ea wane na baŋ qelaŋ eŋane keueno geŋane bakom kitokale, na baŋ eŋet kito geŋane eŋetŋone mawa ganikale.”

content: Koso mane iwa yale ramaike,

content.text: “Batne okanbi, qelaŋ ŋei ŋine, Anutu wane ŋei ŋerep Yuda magu eŋerop!”

content: So mane iwa yale,

content.text: “Waom mawakau, qelaŋ ŋei korop, eŋe mawakau, ŋei ŋerep korop!”

content: So Isaiaŋo koso ramaike,

content.text: “Yese wane komine mane baŋ sariake, eŋe baŋ ŋei waom birakaki, qelaŋ ŋei wareoniake, paki eŋe baŋ wetene eŋano more gekei.”

content: Anutu dereret wane namuŋ, oŋo eŋe detlukka gekeiwane kotoŋino oi bakom so so wet pese, maine qewatŋuniake. Paki Asu Koboboinane zonomŋo baŋ dereretŋine ma togoleki takotke sua ariake.
Paulo Urataine Make Ea Wane Wet Pese Okane Kibi Qeke
Kimakopne, na noŋom wetneŋo mo more, kineŋine detwaremaile, ŋinano mauluk maulukŋo watke pamaike, ŋine dereretŋo korop qewat ŋunge, ea wane ŋine ŋidomka maine ewekeu paki, kito alat nagukei.
Ŋo siluŋ kibi iwa meŋino kito rakake qemaile, yemo miti wane wetke ŋibone more, wet qelot okan ŋunmaile. Na wet qelot okan ŋunmaile, yemo onoka wane Anutuŋo miti urata ea makalane more ninge.

Ea wane na Kristo Yesu wane qelit ŋei gewe paki, qelaŋ ŋei eŋane urata mamaile. Na pris yale Anutu wano ŋine miti don maine ea ra qelaŋane edanmaile, yemo qelaŋ ŋei eŋe maine bakom yale okanbi, Asu Koboboineŋo ebuki koboeu, Anutu wano bakom yale biraongi, ongi menageake.
Ea wane na Kristo Yesurop weneŋ urata mamaile, ea wane na maine Anutu wane urata mamaile, ea wane detpe, wawaine okaniake.

Na yeye kine kine natne ea wane don mi raikale, midaka. Na kine kine weku ea wane donka raikale, yemo Kristoŋo na qesiŋnangi, noŋo qelaŋ ŋei iwenonbe, eŋe Anutu wane miti don dere tewekkei wane, na aŋaneŋo so meteneŋo urata makole.

Asu zonom ningi paki, na masi togole kine mane kine mane ma more yale zonom gorop gekole. Pakiso na kieke Yerusalem kepeo ŋine Kristo wane don maine ea kepe lolike ra sua ari magewe Ilirikum rokopkeke.

Naŋane urata yemo naso baŋem miti don maine ea ra suawe mat natne Kristo wane don kisi mi det okangoi, edo desikei. Eso yale okane mo, ŋei natne edo urata wele nago nagon matokoi, yewao mi makalane nan okanmaike.
Yale okanbe Anutu wane Papiaŋo don mane iwa yale ramaike, ea wane kop okanmaike,

content.text: “Ŋei yewa eŋe eŋane don kisi mane mi rau detkoi, eŋe baŋ kaikei, so yewa eŋe mi detkoi, ŋo baŋ kine detlukkei.”

content: Paulo Eŋe Roma Matko Ariakane Rake
Kine ea wane, na atak loutne ŋinano sarikalane okanbe luknangi met okanmaile.
Na koma loutne ŋinano sari ŋunikalane zok nange, wane ukude iwa yemo kepe iwao uratane mo korop qoe waremaike.

Na mo ŋinano ari ea okanikalane iwa wetkemaile. Na eaka sari ŋune mo koso numane leleki Spain kepeo arikole, na ŋinano lotke marat ŋunbe, mere wetne peseki, ea wane ŋadino ŋido qesiŋ nanbi, yewa arikale.
Naso iwa yemo Anutu wane ŋei ŋerep yewa gemami, eŋane qelit qe more qesiŋ onikalane, Yerusalem matko arikalane okanmaile.

Makedonia so Akaia doku tau tau magu eŋe Yerusalem matko ŋine Anutu wane ŋei magu eŋane keuo ŋine aboŋene midaine gemami, eŋe kito qesiŋ okanone more, bakom more ebonikeiwane, done mo au ma togolekoi.

Eŋe edomka ea okangei wane ongi okanbi menaŋge. Ŋo siluŋ eŋe sotaene pake, ea wane eŋe aboŋene midaine yewa qesiŋongoi, Yuda ŋei eŋe kotoenane morian yewa qelaŋ ŋei eŋerop mapoke ama nagukoi, eso ea wane qelaŋ ŋei eŋe yaleka solaenane morian yewa Yuda ŋei eŋerop maine mapoke ama naguwi menageake.

Na urata iwa ma warewe qoe wareake. Paki na kaikale, eŋe wesi suaine eŋane ra qeturaŋgoi, ea wele mo maine wakonmaike, yemo na urata ea mo koboine meteeno mosikale, na Spain arikalane yemo na numane eaka sari ŋunemo, baŋ arikale.
Na ŋinano sarikale, ea yemo na mo detmaile, na Kristo wano ŋine mosop kelarop wat watko yewarop ma sarikale.
Kimakopne, na Waomze Yesu Kristo wane so Asuŋo wet waep ŋibon okanmaike, ea wane wet qelot ŋidanbe. Ŋine naŋano takotkeu paki, Anutu meŋenka more, naŋane gege uratanane mapik nanikei.

Mapiknane meŋenkau, Anutuŋo Yuda kepeo ŋei ŋei mali malipene midaine eŋane meto maineka warenaniake, paki na Yerusalem matko ŋine Anutu wane ŋei ŋerep magu yewa gemami, eŋane wet pese wane bakom ebonbe, eŋe maine maikei, ea meŋenkaikei.
Ea wane Anutuŋo detki maine okaniakeo yemo Na baŋ wet peserop ŋinano sarikale, paki ŋinerop metpe wet solane peseake.
Anutu, ŋenane peam wane welaine, oŋo ŋinerop korop ge wareake. Weleka.
